description: Figure 8 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the performance of three different Audio-Language models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on two distinct evaluation benchmarks: MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10, representing the percentage of correct responses. The horizontal axis lists the three model names. For each model, two bars are presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing performance on the MMAU benchmark and a purple bar representing performance on the MMAR benchmark, as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. The chart shows that for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 50% while the MMAR accuracy is approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 62% and the MMAR accuracy is approximately 38%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 65% and the MMAR accuracy is approximately 58%. The bars are arranged in the order of the model names along the horizontal axis and are not sorted by height. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their standard presentation.
